source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chemical nature of hormones (PDF 57-59).

blocks.text: Hormones ko unki chemical nature (kimiyai banawat) ke lehaz se groups mein baanta jata hai. Kitab kehti hai 'teen' bare groups hain, lekin aage chaar groups batati hai: peptide aur protein, glycoprotein, amino acid derivatives aur steroid hormones.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke hormones ke 'three main chemical categories' (teen bare kimiyai groups) hain, magar foran baad chaar groups bayan karti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke yahan hormones ke chaar bare kimiyai groups hain: (1) peptide aur protein, (2) glycoprotein, (3) amino acid derivatives, (4) steroid hormones.

Yeh amino acids ki chains (zanjeeron) se bane hote hain. Yeh water-soluble (pani mein hal hone wale) hain, yani khoon mein asaani se ghul jate hain. Lekin yeh cell membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte. Is liye yeh cell ki sateh (surface) par maujood receptors se jurte hain. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Peptide aur protein hormones
rows: Khoon mein glucose ki miqdar kam karta hai.
Khoon mein glucose ki miqdar barhata hai.
Growth aur cells ki taqseem (cell reproduction) barhata hai.
Bachche ki paidaish ke waqt muscles ko sukerta (contract karwata) hai.

blocks.text: Glycoproteins "conjugated proteins" (jore hue proteins) hain: in mein protein ke saath ek carbohydrate (sugar) group juda hota hai. Yeh bare, pecheeda (complex) aur polar molecules hain, is liye yeh bhi cell membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Glycoprotein hormones
rows: Thyroid gland se thyroxine banwata hai.
Sperm banne ya anday (egg) ki nashonuma ko barhata hai.
Auraton mein ovulation shuru karta hai aur mardon mein testosterone chhurwata hai.

blocks.text: Yeh chhote molecules hain jo ek hi amino acid (aam taur par tyrosine ya tryptophan) se bante hain. Yeh cell membrane ke paar ja sakte hain ya nahin, is ka faisla is par hai ke yeh protein jaisa bartao karte hain ya lipid (charbi) jaisa. Epinephrine aur norepinephrine membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte, jabke thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine ja sakte hain. Misalein:

blocks.title: Tidbit: pehla hormone kaise mila
blocks.text: 1902 mein do British scientists, Bayliss aur Starling, digestive system (hazme ka nizam) par tehqeeq kar rahe the ke unhon ne hormone daryaft kiya. Unhon ne dekha ke jab tezabi (acidic) gastric juice chhoti aant mein aata hai to ek madda khoon mein chhoot'ta hai, jise unhon ne “secretin” ka naam diya. Secretin pancreas tak pohanch kar use pancreatic juice chhorne par uksata hai.

blocks.caption: Amino acid derivatives hormones
rows: Fauri “fight or flight” (lado ya bhago) jawab.
Blood pressure aur chaukanna-pan (alertness) barhata hai.
Metabolism ki raftar qaboo karta hai.
Jism ka darja-e-hararat (temperature) aur dil ki dharkan qaboo karta hai.

blocks.text: Yeh hormones cholesterol (ek qism ka lipid) se bante hain. Proteins ke bar-aks steroids lipid-soluble (charbi mein hal hone wale) hain. Is liye yeh cell membrane ke paar ja kar seedha nucleus ko hidayat de sakte hain. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Steroid hormones
rows: Metabolism qaboo karta hai aur jism ko stress (dabao) ka muqabla karne mein madad deta hai.
Gurdon (kidneys) ko namak aur pani ka tawazun rakhne mein madad deta hai.
Mardana reproductive tissues aur khasusiyat qaboo karta hai.
Zanana reproductive system aur us ke chakkar (cycle) ko qaboo karte hain.

blocks.text: Endocrine glands koi khaas stimulus (uksane wali cheez) milne par apne hormones chhorte hain. Woh hormones khoon mein chhorte hain, aur khoon hormone ko tamam cells tak le jata hai. Har hormone sirf apne target cells par asar karta hai. Target cells mein receptors hote hain, aur har receptor ek khaas hormone se jurta hai. Jab hormone receptor se jurta hai to yeh jor aise waqiat shuru karta hai jin se cell ke andar tabdeeliyan aati hain. Receptors cell membrane par, cytoplasm mein ya cell ke nucleus mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit: hormones aur neurotransmitters
blocks.text: Hormones aur neurotransmitters dono chemical messengers hain. Farq yeh hai ke hormones endocrine system ka hissa hain aur neurotransmitters nervous system ka. Hormones aam taur par der se asar karte hain aur un ka asar zyada der tak rehta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa: jo hormone pani mein hal hai (peptide, protein, glycoprotein, epinephrine) woh membrane paar nahin kar sakta, is liye us ke receptors cell ki sateh par hote hain. Jo charbi mein hal hai (steroids, aur thyroxine/T₃) woh membrane paar kar ke cell ke andar (cytoplasm ya nucleus) receptors se jurta hai.

blocks.prompt: Insulin aur testosterone ke receptors kahan hote hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Insulin peptide hormone hai, pani mein hal hota hai aur cell membrane paar nahin kar sakta, is liye us ke receptors cell ki sateh par hote hain. Testosterone steroid hai, charbi mein hal hota hai aur membrane paar kar leta hai, is liye us ke receptors cell ke andar (cytoplasm ya nucleus mein) hote hain.

items: Hormones ke chaar kimiyai groups: peptide/protein (insulin, glucagon, GH, oxytocin), glycoprotein (TSH, FSH, LH), amino acid derivatives (epinephrine, norepinephrine, T₄, T₃) aur steroids (cortisol, aldosterone, testosterone, estrogen, progesterone).
Peptide aur glycoprotein hormones membrane paar nahin karte: receptors sateh par. Steroids cholesterol se bante hain aur membrane paar kar ke nucleus tak hidayat dete hain.
Har hormone sirf us target cell par asar karta hai jis mein us ka receptor ho; receptors membrane, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein hote hain.
